data.one_liner: Generates SVG identicon strings from a text input.
data.what_it_does: The package hashes a given string and creates a deterministic SVG identicon. It provides customization options for colors, saturation, and background. The output is a raw SVG string that can be rendered with any SVG widget.
use_when: You need lightweight, deterministic avatar icons without external image assets
You want to generate identicons on the fly in Dart or Flutter
You prefer a pure‑Dart solution without platform channels
avoid_when: You need built‑in widget rendering of the identicon
You require raster image formats (PNG/JPG) instead of SVG
strengths: Supports null‑safety and works on all Flutter platforms
weaknesses: Only produces SVG strings, you must add a renderer yourself
No caching or image generation utilities included
data.minimal_example:
String rawSvg = Jdenticon.toSvg('example');
Widget icon = SvgPicture.string(rawSvg, width: 64, height: 64);
